mapper.sql: SELECT st.id, st.user_id, st.stu_no, st.dept_id, st.major_id, st.class_name, st.grade_year, st.enroll_year, st.total_credit, st.create_time, st.update_time, su.real_name AS realName, su.gender AS gender, su.phone AS phone, su.email AS email, su.status AS status, d.dept_name AS deptName, m.major_name AS majorName FROM student st INNER JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = st.user_id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id = st.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = st.major_id AND m.deleted = 0
